text: a differential measurement reported zero verdict flips because its corpus could not produce the shape being tested: citations were generated from declaration lines only, so a declaration and an operator-adjacent use of the same name never appeared in one citation, and the bulk of the corpus was a language whose grammar puts none of the characters under test beside an identifier. Re-run with citations that reach a use site, the same corpus showed the flips. The extractor and the property under test shared an assumption, which is what made the silence unreadable.
source: codex and fresh-context reviews of 6e70a2f..44b1a7d, 2026-09-04; the measurement was mine
